entities.summary: Constancia Mangue Nsue Okomo, also known as Constancia Mangue de Obiang, is the First Lady of Equatorial Guinea. She is married to President Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo and mother of First Vice President Teodoro Nguema Obiang Mangue.
